llm.summary: This skill provides a strategy-coaching framework without requesting credentials, executing code, or making business changes.

dimensions.detail: The audit requests calendar, spending, and hiring observations relevant to the user's case, but does not direct broad searches or access to private accounts.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only SKILL.md, with no installers, executable scripts, or dependencies. Publisher links do not require remote execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions govern the coaching conversation and proposed plans; they do not authorize executing spending, staffing, or account changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: A table invites recording observed failure examples in the document; no background workers, privileged access, or automatic persistence mechanism is specified.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The questions, evidence requirements, and planning templates fit its stated strategy-coaching purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Share only the business or personal details needed for the audit, and anonymize any examples saved in the skill. Proposed staffing or spending cuts remain recommendations for your decision. Independent artifact inspection supports the scanners' lack of findings.
